Applications Tested  
This ELISA set is for the quantitative detection of human CCL3 (MIP-1 alpha) in serum, plasma, and tissue culture supernatant samples. This assay has been validated for the detection of endogenous human CCL3 with supernatant collected from cultures of normal human peripheral blood monocytes stimulated with LPS. It is recommended that serum and plasma samples be diluted at least 2-fold with the included Assay Diluent in order to ensure optimal recovery.

This assay was evaluated for specificity on a panel of 72 recombinant cytokines at 100 ng/mL. No significant crossreactivity was observed, including to human CCL4 and mouse CCL3.

HuMIP-1 alpha, when tested in parallel with HuMIP-1 beta, is a more potent lymphocyte chemoattractant with a broader range of concentration-dependent chemoattractant specificities. HuMIP-1 alpha at a concentration of 100 pg/ml attracts B cells and cytotoxic T cells, whereas at higher concentrations (10 ng/ml), the migration of these cells appears diminished, and the migration of CD4+ T cells is enhanced. Thus, in this assay system, HuMIP-1 alpha and -1 beta have differential attractant activities for subsets of immune effector cells, with HuMIP-1 alpha having greater effects than HuMIP-1 beta, particularly on B cells.
